LOWER LEFT, small: ULBUL kneeling, satgat, white hemp, salt sack, looking up. MIDGROUND, larger: JUMONG sitting on a rock in the steam, RED headband, RED po, CLEAN-SHAVEN, SERIOUS, looking at the boy. FARTHER, paler translucent watercolor ancestor-spirits: THIRD of the sheet = King SUCHUN, gold Goguryeo crown, deep red silk, stern, a pale king in the steam. FOURTH = Prince DOLGO, tall black cap, red court robe, warm face, no crown, paler still. The two spirits dissolve into the steam the way the Silla cavern goddesses appear in mist — present, not a lineup. Huge quiet negative space. #e8563f as the hard key on Jumong's silk, never a glow. Faces drawn webtoon, world painted watercolor-and-oil. No text.
